package task

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

type StarterArchiveUploader interface {
	UploadStarterArchive(ctx context.Context, taskID string, originalFilename string, archiveData []byte) (string, error)
}

type StarterArchiveActivator interface {
	ActivateStarterArchive(ctx context.Context, fileID string) error
}

type UploadStarterArchiveInput struct {
	TaskID           string
	OriginalFilename string
	ArchiveData      []byte
}

type UploadStarterArchiveOutput struct {
	StarterFiles []domain.TaskFileStorage
}

type UploadStarterArchive struct {
	Tasks     repository.TaskRepository
	TaskFiles repository.TaskFileStorageRepository
	Uploader  StarterArchiveUploader
	Activator StarterArchiveActivator
	Tx        repository.TransactionManager
}

func (useCase UploadStarterArchive) Handle(
	ctx context.Context,
	input UploadStarterArchiveInput,
) (*UploadStarterArchiveOutput, error) {
	taskID := strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskID)
	if taskID == "" || len(input.ArchiveData) == 0 {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if useCase.Tasks == nil || useCase.TaskFiles == nil || useCase.Uploader == nil || useCase.Activator == nil || useCase.Tx == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := useCase.Tasks.Get(ctx, taskID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	fileID, err := useCase.Uploader.UploadStarterArchive(
		ctx,
		taskID,
		input.OriginalFilename,
		input.ArchiveData,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	starterFiles := []domain.TaskFileStorage{{
		TaskID:        taskID,
		Type:          domain.TaskFileStorageTypeStarterArchive,
		FileStorageID: fileID,
		Order:         1,
	}}
	var previousFiles []domain.TaskFileStorage
	if err := useCase.Tx.WithTx(ctx, func(ctx context.Context) error {
		var err error
		previousFiles, err = useCase.TaskFiles.ListByTask(ctx, taskID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return useCase.TaskFiles.ReplaceForTask(ctx, taskID, starterFiles)
	}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if err := useCase.Activator.ActivateStarterArchive(ctx, fileID); err != nil {
		activationErr := fmt.Errorf("activate starter archive: %w", err)
		compensationCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 10*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		if restoreErr := useCase.Tx.WithTx(compensationCtx, func(ctx context.Context) error {
			return useCase.TaskFiles.ReplaceForTask(ctx, taskID, previousFiles)
		}); restoreErr != nil {
			return nil, errors.Join(activationErr, fmt.Errorf("restore previous starter files: %w", restoreErr))
		}
		return nil, activationErr
	}
	return &UploadStarterArchiveOutput{StarterFiles: starterFiles}, nil
}
